title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: Sunday, November 1, 2026 - Markets Closed (Summary from Friday, Oct 30, 2026)

sections.title: Market Pulse: Tech Sell-off Dominates Last Session

items.headline: Wall Street experiences significant downturn driven by tech stocks, ending October on a negative note.
items.summary: U.S. stock markets closed sharply lower on Friday, October 30, as concerns over the profitability of substantial AI investments intensified following disappointing earnings and weak guidance from major tech players like Intel and Amazon. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite recorded its worst day since June, leading a broader market decline.

items.statContext: Fell 1.82% (-140.32 points) on Friday, its worst day since June.
Dropped 2.86% (-747.72 points), marking its worst day since June and lowest close since July 31, 2026.

items.headline: Trent Limited Leads Gainers
items.summary: Trent Limited ($TRENT) rose 5.36% to ₹3,015.10, leading visible gainers.

items.headline: Regeneron Pharma Surges on Strong Earnings
items.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals ($REGN) surged 13.33% to $926.96, after reporting stronger-than-expected Q3 2026 financial and operating results.

items.headline: Intel Plummets on Weak Q4 Guidance
items.summary: Intel ($INTC) plummeted 28.58% to $65.27, marking its worst day since 1974. This substantial drop was triggered by a weaker-than-expected fourth-quarter revenue and earnings forecast, citing a severe PC market slowdown and manufacturing challenges.

items.headline: Reddit Slides on Soft Q4 Outlook
items.summary: Reddit ($RDDT) tumbled 25.17% after beating third-quarter earnings expectations but offering a softer-than-expected fourth-quarter revenue outlook.

items.headline: Energy and Healthcare Lead, Tech and Communication Services Lag
items.summary: On Friday, the Energy sector led with a 1.91% gain, primarily due to rising oil prices and strong earnings from companies like ExxonMobil ($XOM) and Chevron ($CVX). Healthcare also saw gains. Conversely, the Information Technology sector lagged significantly with a 4.24% loss, primarily driven by the tech sell-off. Communication Services also declined by 1.9%. For the month of October, Energy was the best-performing sector in the S&P 500, while Communication Services and Technology were the worst, with Communication Services down over 9% and Technology down 7.5%.

items.headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady; Treasury Yields Decline Amid Tech Sell-off
items.summary: The Federal Reserve left its policy-rate target unchanged at 3.75%-4.00% earlier in the week, following a 10-2 vote. Treasury yields fell on Friday, with the 10-year Treasury yield dropping 6 basis points to 4.93%, as investors sought safer assets amidst the tech stock sell-off.

items.headline: Key Earnings: Intel Disappoints, Energy Giants Shine
items.summary: Intel's disappointing fourth-quarter revenue forecast led to a nearly 29% plunge, fueling worries about the return on AI investments. Conversely, ExxonMobil ($XOM) announced strong third-quarter 2026 earnings of $15.4 billion, or $3.72 per share, and Chevron ($CVX) reported earnings of $9.9 billion ($5.06 per share), with both energy giants hitting all-time highs on soaring refining profits. AbbVie ($ABBV) also reported strong third-quarter net revenues of $17.404 billion.
